name: Jamaica Inn
insider_take: This legendary boutique resort has been Jamaica's most elegant hideaway since 1950, where Ian Fleming penned James Bond novels and countless celebrities found their Caribbean sanctuary.
whats_special: Jamaica Inn sits on a pristine private beach along Ocho Rios' coveted coastline, featuring just 55 suites spread across 700 feet of powdery white sand. The property maintains its colonial charm with no TVs, radios, or phones in rooms, creating an authentic digital detox experience. Each suite boasts a private veranda overlooking the turquoise Caribbean Sea.
pro_tip: Book the White Suite where Ian Fleming stayed while writing "Dr. No" and "Goldfinger" - it's the same balcony where he crafted some of Bond's most iconic adventures.
dont_miss: The nightly cocktail hour on the Champagne Terrace at sunset, snorkeling at the nearby Blue Hole (a 180-foot deep natural pool), and exploring Dunn's River Falls just 10 minutes away. The resort's croquet lawn and the intimate Regency Restaurant offer quintessential old-world Caribbean elegance.
pros: Intimate boutique property with classic Caribbean charm
Private white sand beach on Ocho Rios coastline
Historic elegance with timeless colonial architecture
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
